summary.text: Daniel Holtmeyer is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A journalist turned small business owner, he lives in Rogers and says he is running to protect voting and ballot-initiative rights and to make housing and health care easier to afford.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Holtmeyer earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska, Lincoln, in 2012 and a graduate degree from the University of Arkansas in 2023.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked for years as a reporter, including five years at the Northwest Arkansas Democrat-Gazette and two years at the Northwest Arkansas Council, where he was its first recycling program manager.

He said he now runs a native plant nursery and offers photography services, holds a master's degree in geography from the University of Arkansas, Fayetteville, and has lived in District 15 for four years.
Holtmeyer listed public health and safety, voter access, immigration, housing and the environment as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
